mapper.select: SELECT bs.id AS slot_id, bs.slot_start, bs.slot_end, bs.ticket_type, tt.name AS ticket_name, bs.price, (bs.total_stock - bs.sold_stock) AS remaining, tt.limit_per_slot FROM booking_slot bs JOIN sys_ticket_type tt ON tt.code = bs.ticket_type WHERE bs.spot_id = #{spotId} AND bs.slot_date = #{slotDate} AND bs.status = 1 ORDER BY bs.slot_start, bs.ticket_type
SELECT id, total_stock, sold_stock FROM booking_slot WHERE slot_date >= #{today} AND status = 1
